points.title: The 是 sentence
points.detail: 是 (shì) links two nouns and is negated with 不: 我是学生 (wǒ shì xuésheng) "I am a student"; 他不是老师 (tā bú shì lǎoshī) "he is not a teacher". It is not used with adjectives.

points.title: Yes/no questions with 吗
points.detail: Adding 吗 (ma) to the end of a statement makes a yes/no question, and the word order does not change: 你是学生吗？(nǐ shì xuésheng ma?) "Are you a student?"

points.title: Asking a name with 请问 and 姓
points.detail: 请问 (qǐngwèn) politely opens a question, and 姓 (xìng) asks for or gives a surname: 请问，你姓什么？(qǐngwèn, nǐ xìng shénme?) "May I ask what your surname is?"

points.title: 也 and 都 before the verb
points.detail: 也 (yě) "also" and 都 (dōu) "all" stand before the verb, never at the end: 我也是学生 (wǒ yě shì xuésheng); 我们都是学生 (wǒmen dōu shì xuésheng).

points.title: 你好, 再见, 谢谢
points.detail: 你好 (nǐ hǎo) is the everyday greeting and 您好 (nín hǎo) its polite form; 再见 (zàijiàn) is goodbye and 谢谢 (xièxie) is thanks.

points.title: 名字, 姓, 贵姓
points.detail: 名字 (míngzi) is a full name, 姓 (xìng) a surname, and 贵姓 (guìxìng) the polite way to ask for one: 您贵姓？(nín guìxìng?)

points.title: Asking numbers with 几 and 多少
points.detail: 几 (jǐ) asks for a small number and needs a measure word, while 多少 (duōshao) asks for any amount and often takes none: 你有几本书？(nǐ yǒu jǐ běn shū?); 这个多少钱？(zhège duōshao qián?)

points.title: Measure words: 个, 本, 口
points.detail: A number and a noun need a measure word between them; 个 (gè) is the general one, 本 (běn) counts books and 口 (kǒu) counts family members: 三个人 (sān gè rén); 两本书 (liǎng běn shū).

points.title: Dates and days of the week
points.detail: Dates run from the largest unit to the smallest: 2026年9月27日 (èr líng èr liù nián jiǔ yuè èrshíqī rì); weekdays are 星期 (xīngqī) plus a number, 星期一 to 星期六, with 星期日 or 星期天 for Sunday.

points.title: Telling the time
points.detail: 现在几点？(xiànzài jǐ diǎn?) asks the time, and the answer uses 点 (diǎn) for the hour and 分 (fēn) for the minute: 现在八点半 (xiànzài bā diǎn bàn) "it is half past eight".

points.title: 今天, 明天, 昨天
points.detail: 今天 (jīntiān) is today, 明天 (míngtiān) tomorrow and 昨天 (zuótiān) yesterday; 上午, 下午 and 晚上 divide the day into morning, afternoon and evening.

points.title: 点, 分, 半, 刻
points.detail: 点 (diǎn) is the hour and 分 (fēn) the minute; 半 (bàn) means half past and 一刻 (yí kè) a quarter: 三点一刻 (sān diǎn yí kè) "a quarter past three".

points.title: Possession and description with 的
points.detail: 的 (de) links a possessor or a description to a noun: 我的爸爸 (wǒ de bàba) "my father"; 中国的茶 (Zhōngguó de chá) "Chinese tea". With close family the 的 is often dropped.

points.title: 有 for having and there being
points.detail: 有 (yǒu) says what someone has or what exists, and is negated with 没有, never 不有: 我有一个哥哥 (wǒ yǒu yí gè gēge); 我没有时间 (wǒ méiyǒu shíjiān).

points.title: Saying where you live and work
points.detail: 在 (zài) before a place says where someone is or does something: 我在家 (wǒ zài jiā) "I am at home"; 我住在北京 (wǒ zhù zài Běijīng) "I live in Beijing".

points.title: Asking about a family with 几口人
points.detail: 家里有几口人？(jiā li yǒu jǐ kǒu rén?) asks how many people are in a family, where 口 (kǒu) is the measure word for family members; the answer is 我家有三口人 (wǒ jiā yǒu sān kǒu rén).

points.title: 爸爸, 妈妈, 哥哥, 姐姐
points.detail: 爸爸 (bàba) is father, 妈妈 (māma) mother, 哥哥 (gēge) elder brother and 姐姐 (jiějie) elder sister; 弟弟 (dìdi) and 妹妹 (mèimei) are younger siblings.

points.title: 工作, 公司, 医生, 学生
points.detail: 工作 (gōngzuò) is work or to work and 公司 (gōngsī) a company; 医生 (yīshēng) is a doctor and 学生 (xuésheng) a student: 我妈妈是医生 (wǒ māma shì yīshēng).

points.title: 这 and 那 with a measure word
points.detail: 这 (zhè) "this" and 那 (nà) "that" need a measure word before a noun: 这个 (zhège) "this one"; 那本书 (nà běn shū) "that book"; 这些 and 那些 are the plurals.

points.title: 太……了 for excess
points.detail: 太 (tài) before an adjective with 了 (le) after it expresses excess: 太贵了 (tài guì le) "too expensive"; 太好了 (tài hǎo le) means "great".

points.title: Asking a price with 多少钱
points.detail: 多少钱？(duōshao qián?) asks the price, and the spoken word for the yuan is 块 (kuài): 五块 (wǔ kuài) "five yuan"; 这个多少钱？(zhège duōshao qián?)

points.title: Ordering with 要 and 想
points.detail: 要 (yào) states what you want and 想 (xiǎng) is softer, "would like to"; both take the thing or the verb directly: 我要一杯茶 (wǒ yào yì bēi chá) "I would like a cup of tea".

points.title: 米饭, 面条, 饺子, 茶
points.detail: 米饭 (mǐfàn) is cooked rice, 面条 (miàntiáo) noodles, 饺子 (jiǎozi) dumplings and 茶 (chá) tea; 杯 (bēi) is the measure word for a cup of liquid.

points.title: 商店, 超市, 贵, 便宜
points.detail: 商店 (shāngdiàn) is a shop and 超市 (chāoshì) a supermarket; 贵 (guì) is expensive and 便宜 (piányi) cheap: 这个很便宜 (zhège hěn piányi) "this is very cheap".

points.title: Asking how to get somewhere with 怎么
points.detail: 怎么 (zěnme) asks how, and the answer uses 坐 (zuò) with a vehicle: 去火车站怎么走？(qù huǒchēzhàn zěnme zǒu?) "How do I get to the train station?"; 坐地铁 (zuò dìtiě) "take the metro".

points.title: 从……到…… for from and to
points.detail: 从 (cóng) … 到 (dào) … marks one place or time through to another: 从家到学校 (cóng jiā dào xuéxiào) "from home to school"; 从八点到十点 (cóng bā diǎn dào shí diǎn) "from eight to ten".

points.title: Giving directions with 往 and 向
points.detail: 往 (wǎng) or 向 (xiàng) plus a direction tells where to go: 往前走 (wǎng qián zǒu) "go straight ahead"; 向左 (xiàng zuǒ) "to the left"; 向右 (xiàng yòu) "to the right".

points.title: Asking where with 在哪儿
points.detail: 在哪儿？(zài nǎr?) asks where something is, and 这儿 or 那儿 answer: 洗手间在哪儿？(xǐshǒujiān zài nǎr?) "Where is the toilet?"; 在那儿 (zài nàr) "over there".

points.title: 火车站, 机场, 地铁, 公交车
points.detail: 火车站 (huǒchēzhàn) is a train station, 机场 (jīchǎng) an airport, 地铁 (dìtiě) the metro and 公交车 (gōngjiāochē) a bus; 票 (piào) is a ticket.

points.title: 左, 右, 前, 后, 旁边
points.detail: 左 (zuǒ) is left, 右 (yòu) right, 前 (qián) front, 后 (hòu) back and 旁边 (pángbiān) beside: 银行在书店旁边 (yínháng zài shūdiàn pángbiān) "the bank is beside the bookshop".
